newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 10 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 10 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 10 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Lyons Twp HSD, Ill., $10.875 million school bonds.
--Mason County CSD, Mich., $3.96 million building and site bonds.
--Pewano-Westphalia, Mich., $7.135 million school building and site bonds.
--Gallup McKinley School District No.1, N.M., $5 million school building general obligation bonds.
--East Pennsboro S.D., Pa., $8.175 million and $1.115 million GOs as a direct purchase.
--Lehighton Area S.D., $4.995 million GOs as a direct purchase.
